supporting_pages.title: IBM Db2 \_|\_ Integration Connectors \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Supported data types The following are the data types supported by the IBM DB2 connector: DOUBLE LONGVARCHAR(n) TIME SMALLINT DECIMAL(p, s) INTEGER TIMESTAMP DATE FLOAT BLOB CHAR(n) VARCHAR(n) REAL VARBINARY BOOLEAN GRAPHIC VARGRAPHIC BIGINT Create connections using Terraform You can use the Terraform resource to create a new connection.
Before you begin Before using the IBM DB2 connector, do the following tasks: In your Google Cloud project: Ensure that network connectivity is set up.
System limitations The IBM DB2 connector can process 40 transactions per second, per node , and throttles any transactions beyond this limit.

supporting_pages.title: Azure AD (Entra ID) \_|\_ Integration Connectors \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Selecting this, displays the following options: Enable event subscription with entity and actions : Select this option to use the connection for both event subscription and connector operations (entities and actions).
To enable data enrichment, you must configure the connection for both event subscription and connector operations (entities and actions).
Action: An action is a first class function that is made available to the integration through the connector interface.
